**Risk flags:**
- Director 1 holds 55.65% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Gemilang Mega Systems Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited technology firm incorporated on 14 December 1994 in Pulau Pinang. It develops accounting software for small businesses and is owned primarily by an individual director who holds 55.65% of the shares, with a second director holding the remainder; there are no corporate shareholders. The company reported revenues of RM 205.1 million (2022), RM 221.8 million (2023) and RM 266.0 million (2024). After losses in 2022 and 2023, it posted a profit after tax of RM 16.8 million in 2024, with an unqualified audit each year.
